blocks.text: The two general criteria for an indicator to be used in a titration are:

items: The pH at the end of the titration should be close to the indicator’s neutral point.
The indicator should indicate a sharp color change near the equivalence point of the titration.

blocks.text: Each pH indicator changes color over a defined range of pH, known as the indicator range. An indicator changes color over a range of about 2 pH units.
